reply_text:
Reviewed `phone-normalize` at `173e408` against `main`. **I’d fix one issue before merging.**

**[P2] Only the first space is removed — `src/normalize.js:4`**
`replace(' ', '')` leaves subsequent spaces behind, so all three examples advertised in the README throw `bad number` instead of queueing:
- `+44 20 7946 0958`
- `0044 20 7946 0958`
- `+1 (415) 555-0100`

For example, the first normalizes to `+4420 7946 0958`, which fails validation. Remove spaces globally and add an end-to-end `queueText` test using these examples; the current normalization test has only one space and misses this.

**Checks:** All 5 existing tests pass; I reproduced the failures above. No code changes made.
